title: Multiline

fields.name: multiline.parser
fields.description: Specify one or multiple [Multiline Parser definitions](/manual/3.2/administration/configuring-fluent-bit/multiline-parsing.md) to apply to the content.

fields.name: multiline.key_content
fields.description: Key name that holds the content to process.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Mode can be parser for regex concat, or partial_message to concat split docker logs.

fields.name: flush_ms
fields.description: Flush time for pending multiline records.

fields.name: emitter_name
fields.description: Name for the emitter input instance which re-emits the completed records at the beginning of the pipeline.

fields.name: emitter_storage.type
fields.description: The storage type for the emitter input instance.

fields.name: emitter_mem_buf_limit
fields.description: Set a limit on the amount of memory the emitter can consume if the outputs provide backpressure.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The Multiline Filter helps to concatenate messages that originally belong to one context but were split across multiple records or log lines.
